# ChatBox AI
> Advanced Multi-Model AI Assistant

ChatBox AI is a comprehensive artificial intelligence platform that provides access to multiple state-of-the-art AI models in a single unified interface.

## Models Available
- GPT-4o (OpenAI)
- Claude 4.7 Sonnet (Anthropic)
- Gemini Pro 1.5 (Google)
- Llama 3.1 (Meta)
- Mistral
- NVIDIA Nemotron Omni (Multimodal)
- Image Generation (FLUX.1 Schnell, Qwen Image 2.1, Stable Diffusion)

## Key Features
- **AI Chat**: Switch between 15+ models mid-conversation with context memory.
- **Image Generation**: Create visuals from text using multiple leading engines.
- **Code Assistant**: Write, debug, and explain code in over 50 programming languages.
- **Deep Research**: Real-time web search capabilities with citations and source verification.
- **File Analysis**: Upload and analyze PDFs, images, videos, and audio (up to 10MB per file) via multimodal models.
- **Voice AI**: Voice interaction support.
- **Website Builder**: Generate simple websites via AI.

## Pricing
- **Free Plan**: Access to basic models, 50 messages/day, 10 image generations/day, 7-day chat history.
- **Pro Plan**: Unlimited access to premium models, unlimited messages, advanced features (voice, file upload, website builder).
